recent_excerpts: CVE-2026-44664 (CVSS 6.1) in fast-xml-builder lets attackers break out of XML comments and inject arbitrary content via triple-dash sequences; fixed in version 1.1.6.
Socket and StepSecurity found backdoored node-ipc versions 9.1.6, 9.2.3, and 12.0.1 exfiltrate SSH keys, AWS credentials, and env files from developer machines.
OpenAI says two employees' devices were compromised in the TeamPCP Mini Shai-Hulud campaign, forcing rotation of code-signing certificates across macOS, Windows, iOS, and Android.
